meaning:
εὔσπλαγχνος, -ον
(εὖ, σπλάγχνον, which see), [in Man.1.7 (Camb. Manual LXX, iii, 825) ;]
1. in Hippocr., as medical term (LS, see word).
2. Metaphorical (cf. εὐσιλαγχνία, Eurip., Rhes., 192), in NT, tenderhearted, compassionate: Eph.4:32, 1Pe.3:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
